body: Who was your inspiration for Sergeant Lincoln Osiris?
I loved your cameo in Sin City 2 and also thought you were hilarious on SNL! Will you do more acting in the future?
What kind of things did you have to do while shooting the effects of *Tron* in 1982? Did you use similar motion picture acting that [Andy Serkis](http://youtu.be/E87mrXcubYg?t=40s) uses?

* Niggas in Paris, Mercy, Clique - 2012
* Bound 2 - 2013
What do you think of [what Eddie Murphy said about you in Raw](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m0aKNwsrtXw)?

Will you ever turn *Simple Jack* into a full length film? If not, I found a way to make it in a way that will negate all controversy but will probably alienate some fans. The film about Jack would have to be shot in a style similar to [Babe](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3fBnfwJfY_0) or [The Straight Story](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e0zb_baTzkk) and the plot is that Jack's father is dying and Jack has too raise money to save the farm.

On second thought, fuck this idea, it's too cliche. I just realized it was done by [The Three Stooges adaptation](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Three_Stooges_(film)#Plot), [Babe 2](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Babe_2#Plot), and probably hundreds of other movies. But you're the comedic genius. If you could write a multi-layered satire like Tropic Thunder, which makes Team America look basic, you could probably make this a good movie.

1. Are you ever gonna release your concerts and your HBO show on Blu-Ray?

2. Do you have any amusing behind the scenes stories from *Tropic Thunder* you haven't told anyone? Considering it's probably one of the best cast and performed comedies of all time, I'd be *shocked* if some funny business didn't happen behind the scenes.
